title: a user native module this build cannot load, diagnosed rather than loaded silently

native_module.name: kr_wrong_abi
native_module.note: What this case ships is a file named like a module whose contents this build's loader refuses, so what it proves is the diagnosis rather than an editor-ABI mismatch: the loader names the module it would not load, the shell's own list of loaded modules does not hold it, and the integration is still qualified afterwards. A module compiled against another ABI of this shell would prove the mismatch itself and needs a compiler and that shell's headers at qualification time, which this corpus does not have.
